avis.titre: A little is all you need
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using this Charlotte Tilbury Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery Serum I have to say that my skin does look brighter and more radiant. The serum is velvety in texture and a little goes a long way, but it also takes a bit to absorb. While I do feel like it is effective I don't particularly like the smell. It smells a bit "old lady" to me and sometimes can be overwhelming.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review.This is a very light weight serum and soaks in your skin really good. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This lightweight product works great on stubborn dark spots. Charlotte Tilbury's formula as always is light and never sticky. It goes in refreshing and has lightened my almost permanent dark spots under my eyes. Must have!
This is under correcting gave my eyes a beautiful radiance I will pre-purchase it again

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It was really smooth and layered on thin. It didn't have too much of a scent and it was light. After a few weeks you will notice a difference, spots become lighter. It's a good product it just takes time as it should.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this serum for several weeks now, so I could provide this honest review after receiving this complimentary product in exchange! and I'm already seeing a visible difference in my skin tone. Overall, I experienced a noticeable difference in my skin - but it did take several weeks for me to see it. It's effective but gentle enough for my skin. Would definitely repurchase once I'm finished when this bottle! Another plus - a little goes a long way!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Okay, so I really wanted to fall in love with this serum and I kinda did… but not fully. The claims are great, and I like what it promises to do. But the scent threw me off. I'm just not into strong, flowery fragrances in my skincare. I wish it was fragrance-free or at least had more of a clean, subtle scent. That alone made it hard for me to stick with it consistently. As for results, I didn't see a major difference in my dark spots, but my skin did look more fresh and radiant. I'd totally be open to trying this again if they ever came out with a fragrance-free version.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tested this out over several weeks & it faded a stubborn patch of pigmentation I had on my cheek. A little goes a long way, so the price point is justified to me. It feels smooth & moisturizing on the skin & doesn't have an overwhelming smell to it.

I'm obsessed with all of Charlotte Tilbury's products, but this one is amazing! I love the way it smells & how it makes my skin feel. It's soothing, but also feels kinda hot like it's working to fight dark spots.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Charlotte Tilbury Dark Spot Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed. I picked it up mainly to target a couple of stubborn sunspots and some old acne marks, and while I didn't expect overnight miracles, I've actually started to see a difference faster than I thought. The texture is super lightweight—it absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, which I really appreciate, especially since I layer it under moisturizer. It plays nicely with makeup too, no pilling or weird texture. As for results, I've noticed my skin tone looks a little more even and brighter overall. Some of the darker spots have started to fade, and my skin just looks a bit healthier and smoother in general. I also haven't had any irritation or breakouts from it, which is always a concern with brightening products. It's definitely on the pricier side, but a little goes a long way, and I'd say it feels like a quality formula. I'm planning to keep using it and see how much more improvement I can get over time. So far, so good!

I have been using the Charlotte Tilbury Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery Serum for about a month now, and so far, I haven't noticed a significant improvement. I appreciate that this serum is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a residue. It has a mild scent that is not overpowering. I'm giving it three stars because I expected to see faster results; however, I understand that most dark spot treatments require patience and time. Overall, I like everything else about the product.

The packaging is so pretty and radiant! I've definitely seen a nice radiance and brighter glow in my skin since I've been using this serum. I love that I can use it under my eyes as well. I'm not too crazy about the scent but it does go away after a while.

avis.titre: Effective but too spendy for me….

I've noticed my skin looks more even and radiant, and newer dark spots have started to fade within a couple weeks. It does have an unpleasant to me fragrance, which might be a downside if you're sensitive to scents. Also, older spots are taking longer to lighten, so it's not an overnight fix. It's definitely a bit expensive, but it feels like it's doing what it claims. I wouldn't personally purchase it as it is just way out of my price range for a cream but I'm not saying it isn't worth it if it is in your price range!

avis.titre: Charlotte Tilbury's Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery S
avis.texte: Charlotte Tilbury's Dark Spot Correcting Radiance Recovery Serum is a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs effortlessly into the skin without feeling sticky or greasy. After a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed a visible improvement in the tone and brightness of my complexion. My skin looked more even and luminous. The formula features ingredients like niacinamide, tranexamic acid, and vitamin C derivatives, all known for their pigmentation-fighting and brightening properties. It's also gentle enough for nightly use without causing irritation or dryness. The scent is subtle and elegant—nothing overpowering—and it layers well under moisturizer and makeup. It's a solid addition to a nighttime skincare routine for those aiming for a clearer, more radiant complexion.
